title: Academic paper project state (structural contract)
description: Structural schema for docs/academic-paper-project-state.template.yaml instances. Enforces types, enum values exactly as documented in template inline comments, id-prefix integrity, and date formats. Deliberately structural: REPLACE_ME placeholders and documented template date placeholders are accepted because placeholder elimination is semantic work owned by the per-contract resolvers, not by this schema. Fields without a documented enum are typed but not enum-constrained; tighten only together with a template comment update and a schema_version bump.
